independence.scope: Independent evaluation of new composition; inherited proof dependency authorship disclosed.

findings.detail: Canonical output uses modulo even if word addition wraps; correct ring decoding separately requires canonical operands and modulus<=2^63.
Induction derives canonical state and dd before each word-add decode. Initial(a,b+c,e), simultaneous update and arbitrary Nat n match intended pure state.
List.range retains old-state observation order; same_fold compares the same abstract decoded-state branch function. It does not prove Rust exceptional branch code.
Canonical decode injective and zero equivalence proved; final_wrap is decoded-state equality at p and0. Canonical natural-value projection is not separately named.

Native add(a+b)%p and initializer/updateorder match model. Model recomputes constantdd in iterate successor while Rust initializes once; pure-value equality only, no matching meter count inferred. Active array slicing, Rust iterator/compiler semantics and whole SieveResult are separate.

trust: Exact pinned shared Lean/mathlib caches; inventory cannot exclude transient concurrent changes. No independent kernel binary rechecker.
